articles.title: EE. UU. quiere construir autos más ligeros: este nuevo microscopio podría encontrar los materiales necesarios
articles.text:
Un microscopio instalado recientemente en el Laboratorio Nacional de Oak Ridge (ORNL), en Tennessee, puede distinguir átomos individuales con una resolución espacial inferior a 0,05 nanómetros.
El equipo, bautizado Thermo Scientific Spectra Ultra, pertenece al Departamento de Energía de Estados Unidos y figura entre los microscopios más avanzados de la red de laboratorios nacionales del país. Su objetivo es acelerar la búsqueda de materiales para aleaciones metálicas más resistentes, imanes permanentes y catalizadores industriales, lo cual apunta a tener un impacto significativo en la industria automotriz.
Un microscopio que combina imagen atómica y análisis químico
El Spectra Ultra es un microscopio electrónico de transmisión por barrido (STEM, por sus siglas en inglés) que integra imágenes a escala atómica, espectroscopia de alta velocidad y flujos de trabajo potenciados por inteligencia artificial. Su resolución le permite examinar la estructura atómica de un material mientras recopila, de manera simultánea, información detallada sobre su composición química.
Allen Haynes, director del consorcio del programa Powertrain Materials Core del Departamento de Energía, explicó que el instrumento permite observar rasgos específicos a escala atómica que determinan la resistencia y la estabilidad de un material.
“Usando el nuevo microscopio, podemos examinar características específicas a escala atómica que influyen en la resistencia y la estabilidad de un material, lo cual ayuda a revelar por qué una aleación liviana se mantiene resistente tras años de vibración, calor y tensión mientras otra comienza a debilitarse”, señaló en un comunicado.
Aleaciones más livianas para la industria automotriz
Según Haynes, los datos que aporta el microscopio resultan determinantes para el desarrollo de nuevos materiales. “Esos datos ayudan a guiar el desarrollo de aleaciones más livianas, resistentes y estables para futuras aplicaciones de transporte”, indicó el especialista. Esa capacidad podría traducirse en vehículos más livianos sin que se comprometa su durabilidad.
El equipo también podría mejorar los imanes permanentes empleados en motores eléctricos. El microscopio puede revelar cómo se distribuyen los minerales críticos dentro de los imanes y, a partir de ese análisis, facilitar la identificación de sustitutos capaces de resistir altas temperaturas.
Haynes agregó que el instrumento también podría extender la vida útil de los catalizadores utilizados en celdas de combustible, manufactura química y producción de fertilizantes. “En conjunto, estas capacidades ofrecen a los científicos una comprensión más profunda de cómo funcionan los materiales y el conocimiento necesario para desarrollar nuevos materiales superiores para la próxima generación de tecnologías que dependen de ellos”, afirmaron los investigadores del ORNL.
Flujos de trabajo automatizados para acelerar la investigación
El equipo de Oak Ridge ya trabaja en flujos de trabajo automatizados que permitirían recolectar y procesar grandes volúmenes de datos sin necesidad de examinar cada muestra de forma manual.
David Cullen, investigador del Grupo de Microanálisis Aplicado y Termofísica del ORNL, explicó que la automatización de partes del proceso proporcionará a los científicos conjuntos de datos mucho más amplios, lo cual revelará con mayor claridad las nanoestructuras que determinan el rendimiento y la durabilidad de los materiales avanzados.
“Todo está diseñado para un alto rendimiento”, declaró Cullen en un comunicado de prensa del laboratorio. “Estamos desarrollando enfoques de microscopía autónoma que pueden aumentar la velocidad con la que generamos comprensión científica”.
Detectar defectos ocultos a lo largo del tiempo
El equipo de investigadores sostuvo que el nuevo microscopio también permitirá rastrear cambios en los materiales a lo largo del tiempo y detectar defectos que de otro modo pasarían inadvertidos.
“En el caso de los vehículos, los fabricantes de automóviles han buscado durante mucho tiempo metales más livianos que puedan mejorar la eficiencia de combustible y la autonomía sin sacrificar la seguridad ni la durabilidad”, concluyó el grupo. Lograr ese equilibrio exige comprender cómo se modifica un material durante años de uso en condiciones reales.

articles.title: Australia Gets Into Amadey Malware Backend, Cuts Off Access to 180,000 Infected Computers
articles.text:
A criminal using the Amadey malware can no longer access or steal data from 180,000 infected computers around the world, including some in Australia, the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) says. The agency's operators gained access to the criminal's operation's backend and cut it off from those computers.
"The next steps that we took were to disconnect that Amadey controller from all those victims," Tauri Gregory, ASD's acting deputy director-general of intelligence, told ABC News in an interview published on October 27.
ASD is Australia's foreign signals intelligence and cyber security agency. Its offensive cyber operations need explicit approval from the Australian government and can disrupt cybercriminals overseas by disabling their infrastructure.
Amadey was sold to criminals as a service in 2018, according to ESET's analysis of Amadey. Each buyer runs its own control panel on its own servers.
Computers infected with Amadey check in with their buyer's command-and-control (C2) server and carry out its orders. Amadey's main job is to install more malware, such as the StealC infostealer. It can also steal credentials and give the buyer remote access to the machine.
The most common ways Amadey reached computers were fake software updates, cracked software installers, and other malware loaders.
The criminal's Amadey operation was one of many. In its tracking, ESET identified 53 separate Amadey botnets that did not share infrastructure.
Disconnecting a controller from its victims also does not undo earlier theft. Credentials stolen by infostealers can sit unused for months before attackers use them, according to Microsoft's analysis. A stolen session cookie can allow an attacker to bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA).
ASD's annual cyber threat report, published on October 27, does not describe the operation.
Amadey's infrastructure was also disrupted in June by Operation Endgame, an international law enforcement operation that works with private partners. Between June 15 and 19, the operation targeted servers associated with Amadey, StealC, and the SocGholish malware.
Australia is one of nine countries whose law enforcement and judicial authorities run Operation Endgame together, according to Europol's June announcement. It was not on Europol's list of countries that took part in the June action week, and the announcement does not mention ASD.
In a separate case, ASD said it received a tip that 5 terabytes of data stolen from a business were for sale. The business did not know it had been hacked. The data included business documents, personal data, and login credentials and passwords.
The agency broke in and destroyed the data before it could be sold. The destroyed files included an estimated 4.8 million stolen from Australians and hundreds of thousands taken from victims in other countries.

articles.title: Logitech Unveils MX Master 4 Special Developer Edition
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 27th 2026
Logitech Unveils MX Master 4 Special Developer Edition
Logitech has released a Developer Edition of its MX Master 4 mouse that was launched back in September 2025. The company says that this is a tribute to the "developers who are shaping the digital world". However, the hardware is identical to the standard MX Master 4. The same 8,000 DPI sensor and MagSpeed scroll wheel capable of 1,000 lines per second. We can mention built-in haptic feedback and the Action Ring button for shortcuts. Then, it also has the same 650 mAh battery with up to 70 days of use, USB-C quick charging, and multi-device pairing. Basically, nothing has changed under the hood or in terms of functionality.
The differences are purely visual, as the new edition uses a two-tone dark and light gray scheme with bright green accents. There are laser-etched syntax annotations including // and </> markup tags, circuit traces, and a {Hello, World} execution prompt. Logitech has also added a few Easter eggs, 0xFF + 1 referencing World Programmers' Day, 09.17 for the Linux Kernel release date, and !04.01 for World Backup Day. The good news is that MX Master 4 Developer Edition costs the same as the standard model. The mouse is currently listed on the Logitech website for $120 / €130, together with the two-year warranty.

articles.title: Elle utilise l’IA pour contester ses impôts : le tribunal la sanctionne avec une amende
articles.text:
Le 4 décembre 2025, Marie-Line X a introduit une requête pour contester un redressement fiscal datant de 2023. Autant dire que cette requête n’a pas été bien reçue. En fait, le tribunal administratif de Rennes (Ille-et-Vilaine) lui a infligé une amende de 500 euros pour recours abusif, comme le rapporte Franceinfo. Parmi tous les éléments qui ont abouti à cette amende, le tribunal a constaté « une requête manifestement écrite à l’aide d’un outil d’intelligence artificielle ».
Une amende de 500 euros pour recours abusif
Pourquoi le tribunal a-t-il infligé à Marie-Line X une amende de 500 euros ? Tout d’abord, la contribuable bretonne avait déjà déposé une requête similaire, qui avait été rejetée. Ensuite, elle a saisi le tribunal administratif de Rennes sans avoir préalablement adressé de réclamation à l’administration fiscale, une démarche obligatoire dans ce type de litige. Marie-Line X assure de son côté être « de bonne foi », avoir « suivi les indications écrites » du Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) et n’avoir « jamais été informée d’une dette en 2023 jusqu’à la notification ». Enfin, et non des moindres, le tribunal a relevé un manque de précision dans ses arguments.
Concernant ce dernier point, le magistrat explique : « les moyens de la requête – laquelle a au demeurant été manifestement écrite à l’aide d’un outil d’intelligence artificielle – ne sont pas assortis des précisions les plus élémentaires permettant au juge d’en apprécier la portée et le bien-fondé ».
Le recours à l’IA pointé du doigt par le tribunal
Le tribunal administratif de Rennes semble avoir été quelque peu agacé par le fait que Marie-Line X ait eu recours à l’intelligence artificielle pour élaborer sa requête, et ce principalement pour deux raisons. D’une part, le recours à l’IA entraînerait une multiplication notable des requêtes judiciaires. La juridiction explique à ce titre : « Dans un contexte marqué par une hausse particulièrement forte du nombre de requêtes (…) devant tous les tribunaux administratifs depuis deux ans, on constate l’usage de plus en plus décomplexé des outils d’intelligence artificielle pour générer des “requêtes” ».
D’autre part, l’IA générerait des requêtes creuses, qui manquent de détails. La juridiction explique qu’ « aux yeux de bien des justiciables, les requêtes “fabriquées par l’IA” ont toutes les apparences de leur côté : un vocabulaire juridique y est employé et le propos paraît structuré ». Cependant : « aux yeux du professionnel du droit, ces requêtes ont souvent un vilain défaut : elles sont creuses et fourmillent de références fallacieuses ».
En fin de compte, le tribunal administratif de Rennes a principalement sanctionné le caractère abusif de la requête de Marie-Line X, et le recours à l’intelligence artificielle ne l’a clairement pas aidé dans cette affaire. Il semble que la juridiction veuille aussi lancer un avertissement pour limiter le nombre de requêtes élaborées à l’aide de l’IA. La présidence du tribunal invite d’ailleurs les justiciables bretons à « utiliser avec tact, discernement et mesure » les outils d’intelligence artificielle. Prudence donc la prochaine fois que vous devrez élaborer ce type de requête, même si, rappelons-le, le recours à l’IA n’est pas le seul élément qui a mené à une amende dans cette affaire.

articles.title: Amazon confirma “crediário” no Brasil; pagamento chega a 12 parcelas • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Amazon confirma “crediário” no Brasil; pagamento chega a 12 parcelas
Nova modalidade oferecida pelo e-commerce pode ser acessada pelo aplicativo. Usuários podem ativar diretamente no aplicativo.
A Amazon confirmou ao Tecnoblog que começou a oferecer um novo parcelamento sem cartão diretamente no aplicativo. O e-commerce se junta a concorrentes como Mercado Livre e Shopee, que já liberam uma espécie de “crediário” para realização de compras. A modalidade está em fase de implementação e pode não aparecer para todos os consumidores.
O Amazon Crédito é apresentado diretamente no site e app da Amazon. Apenas titulares podem solicitá-lo e a operação passa por análise de crédito. A documentação da Amazon indica a cobrança de taxas e de juros, mas os detalhes só são apresentados diretamente ao cliente final.
No fim das contas, trata-se de um empréstimo. Um exemplo fornecido pela Amazon cita o crédito de R$ 100 em 5 meses, com parcelas de R$ 27,74, totalizando R$ 138,70 com os juros. O Custo Efetivo Total (CET) fica em 12% ao mês. A Amazon nos explicou que a modalidade chegará em etapas, e recomendou que os interessados chequem periodicamente se a opção está disponível.
O Amazon Crédito é uma alternativa às compras no cartão de crédito. A ideia é aumentar o leque de opções para adquirir produtos, a exemplo do que já acontece em apps concorrentes. A Shopee, por exemplo, tem o SParcelado.
A ativação do Amazon Crédito pode ser feita da seguinte maneira:
O limite de crédito e a quantidade de parcelas mudam de acordo com o cliente. Nem todos terão direito às 12 vezes num primeiro momento. Isso pode mudar conforme o uso e o pagamento em dia.
O Tecnoblog apurou que o Amazon Crédito não é operado pela Amazon. Na realidade, o consumidor assina o compromisso financeiro com a Celcoin Sociedade de Crédito Direto, que está inscrita sob o CNPJ 48.632.754/0001-90. Esta instituição financeira tem autorização do Banco Central.
Há alguns requisitos básicos para os titulares que desejarem o Amazon Crédito. Segundo a empresa, é necessário ter idade entre 21 e 75 anos, renda mensal de pelo menos R$ 1.500 e documentação válida, assim como endereço no Brasil. Todos os clientes com conta ativa na Amazon podem pedir o Amazon Crédito. Além do cadastro, é necessário passar por uma análise de crédito antes de começar a usar.
Depois de aprovado, o “crediário” é exibido na Amazon. Não é possível utilizá-lo para empréstimos ou compras em outros sites, por exemplo. Uma vez ativo, basta selecionar a modalidade nas opções de pagamento.

articles.title: Russian aerospace maker turns to local AI for aircraft design
articles.text:
Moscow could design an F-22 rival using an AI model from Russia's JPMorgan Chase — Sberbank GigaChat used its LLM for a 'generative design of a new aircraft'
Russian tech initiative integrates LLMs into early-stage aircraft design
- Russia is testing Sberbank's AI model for future aircraft development
- GigaChat could help engineers explore aircraft configurations during preliminary design
- Moscow is turning to domestic software after Western suppliers withdrew
Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) is reportedly experimenting with Sberbank's GigaChat AI model to assist engineers developing future military and civilian aircraft.
The initiative could eventually support work on advanced fighter jets, although UAC has not identified any project intended to challenge America's F-22.
With its aerospace industry facing Western technology restrictions, Moscow is increasingly relying on domestically developed software for aircraft engineering and development.
Sberbank's GigaChat enters aircraft development
This project remains in its experimental phase, with UAC yet to announce a development timetable or identify the aircraft involved in the initiative.
The initiative employs GigaChat, a large language model developed by Russia's largest bank, to explore possible configurations before detailed engineering begins.
Engineers could eventually apply the technology to structural strength assessments and aerodynamic computations, although those capabilities are beyond the scope of the initial experiment.
Rather than replacing conventional engineering methods, the proposed applications involve examining multiple configurations and processing information that would otherwise require extensive analysis.

UAC manufactures Russia's Su-57 and Su-35 combat aircraft, as well as civilian programs, including the MC21 passenger jet, which is currently undergoing extensive component substitution.
However, the corporation has not disclosed whether GigaChat contributes to either fighter program or whether its experimental aircraft has military applications.
UAC general designer Sergey Korotkov supported exploring AI tools where practical engineering requirements justify introducing additional computational tools.
“Digital technology makes it possible to take a larger sample and understand a problem more deeply,” said specialists at United Aircraft Corporation.
The manufacturer nevertheless maintains that AI adoption must remain selective, with individual engineering requirements determining whether particular applications are worthwhile.
Western sanctions accelerate Russia's software replacement
Following the start of the war between Russia and Ukraine in February 2022, major engineering software suppliers withdrew operations, disrupting access to established aerospace development platforms.
Among the departing vendors were Dassault Systèmes, Siemens and Autodesk, whose engineering applications had supported Russian aviation manufacturers for several decades.
To reduce dependence on these suppliers, UAC introduced locally developed alternatives across approximately 4,000 engineering computers at its aircraft design facilities.
The transition also involved replacing nine essential modules responsible for managing aircraft development information throughout different stages of production and maintenance.
In a recent update, UAC reported that digital methods had reduced certain calculations involving hydraulic systems and cabin temperatures considerably.
Engineering tasks previously requiring several months could reportedly be completed within days, although independent verification of these improvements remains unavailable.
Meanwhile, Russia's MC21 passenger aircraft continues experiencing development setbacks as engineers replace imported equipment with components manufactured by domestic suppliers.
Vladimir Putin admitted in June that the programme had slipped by almost two years, with problems involving the wing accounting for part of the delay.
First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov has since set late 2027 as the expected certification date for a version that uses only Russian components.

articles.title: Nvidia RTX GPU vendor Palit denies its Galax factory has closed due to a shortage of chips — company says brand 'continues to operate as usual'
articles.text:
Nvidia RTX GPU vendor Palit denies its Galax factory has closed due to a shortage of chips — company says brand 'continues to operate as usual'
The rumor came amid GPU chip shortages for the RTX 5090.
Palit released an official statement denying recent speculation that it has closed its Galax factory — where it makes Nvidia RTX 50-series GPUs — because it cannot guarantee a sufficient supply of Nvidia chips. According to the company’s press release, its operations continue as usual, it has not shut down any factories, and customers are able to purchase Galax GPUs through existing distributors and retailers for both domestic and international markets.
“We are aware of recent reports and speculation regarding Galax’s business operations. We would like to clarify that these claims are inaccurate,” the company said. “Galax continues to operate as usual. No manufacturing facilities have been shut down, and Galax products remain available through our sales channels in both domestic and international markets.” It also mentioned that Galax and Palit share the same factories, and that production and business operations continue as normal. Nvidia was not immediately available for comment regarding speculation about the availability of chips.
The initial news of a possible Galax closure came as a shock to many, especially as the brand had just launched its latest flagship model, the Galax GeForce RTX 5080 HOF Extreme. The rumors stemmed from an exclusive news report by a Spanish outlet (expand the post above) claiming that Palit could no longer supply Nvidia GPU chips to Galax, meaning it could no longer build graphics cards at that facility, and keeping it operational was no longer viable for the company. Thankfully, the sources were wrong, so we are not going to see another major consumer GPU brand like EVGA leave the market. Still, the speculation that Galax would stop GPU production was not implausible, especially as we’ve been seeing reports that Nvidia was ending RTX 5090 production in favor of more expensive AI data center and professional GPUs.
This wasn’t the first time this year that Galax was rumored to have ended production. Palit Group restructured its operations earlier this year, which brought similar reports of closure for the GPU brand. This was further reinforced after Palit announced that it would consolidate Galax operations at its headquarters in Taiwan. Thankfully, the speculation both then and today is false, and we will continue seeing Galax GPUs on retail shelves. However, it still doesn’t solve the skyrocketing GPU prices brought by the AI-driven memory chip shortage.

articles.title: OpenAI Compaction Flaw Let Researchers Bypass Hidden Reasoning Protections
articles.text:
OpenAI's compaction feature, which shrinks a long conversation to save space, could be turned into a way to copy a model's hidden reasoning out in plain text, security firm Xint has shown.
OpenAI's reasoning models work through a problem before answering, and the service normally returns only the raw reasoning as an encrypted item the user cannot read. The method got past the protections OpenAI added in August against this kind of reasoning theft. OpenAI confirmed the problem and fixed it on October 23, according to Xint.
Xint ran the technique against gpt-5.6-sol, one of OpenAI's reasoning models, using math and algorithm puzzles its researchers wrote themselves. The reasoning it pulled out came from those same requests, and Xint did not claim the method could reach another user's reasoning.
Xint says it cannot prove the copied text is word-for-word the model's real reasoning, because it never had the original to compare against. Two cheaper models each repeated the item and produced the same text, which rules out mistakes in the copying step but leaves open the possibility that compaction reworded the text.
Compaction is an OpenAI feature that uses a model to squeeze a long conversation into a smaller, encrypted item that carries the context forward.
Xint sent a task to gpt-5.6-sol and kept the encrypted reasoning it returned. It then called the compaction step on the same model and told it to copy that reasoning into the compacted item word-for-word, with every space changed to a tab to get past OpenAI's usage-policy filters.
Because compaction items can move between models, Xint passed the item to the cheaper gpt-4.1 and gpt-4o models and asked each to repeat its input exactly, which they did.
The method worked around a fix OpenAI had already shipped. In August, researchers behind a paper called Stolen Thoughts showed that encrypted reasoning from a strong model could be replayed into a weaker model from the same company, which would then repeat it as plain text. OpenAI and others blocked that cross-model replay soon after.
Compaction got past that block, Xint said, because the compaction step runs on the same model that made the reasoning, so it never triggers the cross-model check.
The idea built on Xint's earlier work, called GhostCompact, which showed the compaction step can be pushed to run tasks of the attacker's choosing. Xint has published the code in its GitHub repository.
The fix was on OpenAI's side, so developers who build on the API do not need to change anything. Xint called it an undisclosed fix and said OpenAI paid the researchers a $6,000 reward.
Xint tested only gpt-5.6-sol and did not check whether GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's newer model, is affected. It is not known whether anyone used the method before OpenAI closed it. Xint also argued that fixing this one path may not be enough because, in its view, any server-side step that reads a model's decrypted reasoning and follows the user's instructions could leak it.
OpenAI keeps raw reasoning hidden partly to stop distillation, where one company trains a cheaper model on another's outputs. Raw reasoning makes better training data than the final answer alone, because it shows how the model worked through the problem, which is what makes it worth stealing for a rival.
OpenAI said in September that it had disrupted a July campaign that tried to expose its models' hidden reasoning, and linked a core part of it to people associated with China's Moonshot AI.
Anthropic and a joint U.S. government advisory have each reported China-based labs targeting the hidden reasoning of American models. None of that is tied to Xint's compaction method, which is a demonstration rather than an attack seen in the wild.

articles.title: Imagem do Disney+ fica pior no Brasil, mas preço segue intacto • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Imagem do Disney+ fica pior no Brasil, mas preço segue intacto
Assinatura mais cara perde qualidade de imagem, agora sem 4K e HDR.
O Disney+ Premium passou por uma piora de qualidade no Brasil. Agora, assinantes do plano mais caro perdem a opção de assistir aos conteúdos em 4K e HDR. O preço, em contrapartida, segue o mesmo: R$ 69,90, agora por 1080p de resolução máxima. Em princípio, é a mesma qualidade oferecida nos planos mais em conta, mas uma atualização no site da Disney+ indica outro possível downgrade.
A mudança no streaming chegou silenciosamente, sem nenhum aviso prévio aos clientes. A principal vantagem do plano Premium é a possibilidade de assistir a conteúdos de canais ao vivo, como jogos de futebol via ESPN, por exemplo.
Segundo apuração do Canaltech, a novidade teria base em uma disputa judicial entre a Disney e a InterDigital, dona das patentes que liberam as tecnologias de transmissão. O Tecnoblog procurou a empresa, mas não obteve resposta até o fechamento da matéria.
São três planos oferecidos pelo Disney+ aqui no Brasil: Padrão com anúncios, Padrão sem anúncios e Premium. Antes, a opção mais cara garantia maior qualidade de imagem na exibição, além dos conteúdos de esportes ao vivo da ESPN, entre outros canais. Vantagens em relação a dispositivos simultâneos e downloads também continuam.
Chama atenção a diferença de preços. Do plano intermediário para o Premium, são R$ 20 de diferença. Segundo o site da Disney+ no Brasil, as assinaturas Padrão não têm mais garantia de resolução em 1080p, mas não fica claro se isso significa necessariamente um downgrade de imagem. Veja as opçõs e preços:
Um processo movido pela InterDigital, empresa dos Estados Unidos responsável pelas licenças para uso de tecnologias de transmissão, é apontado como provável “culpado” pela mudança no serviço. A decisão contrária à Disney se deu ainda em setembro de 2025, na 7ª Vara Empresarial do Rio de Janeiro.
No ocasião, a acusação apontava uso indevido dos padrões AVC e HEVC, tecnologias de compressão dos conteúdos em vídeo. O caso também já foi julgado em segunda instância, que manteve a decisão.
Em julho, a Disney também retirou o 4K e o HDR de seus conteúdos na Europa após decisões judiciais semelhantes, limitando o serviço à resolução 1080p em alguns países. Segundo o site What Hi-Fi, a empresa afirmou ter restaurado essa opção em agosto, mas alguns dispositivos ficaram de fora da atualização.

articles.title: Le studio Arkane Lyon joue sa survie avec Xbox : un mois de sursis pour éviter la fermeture
articles.text:
Le studio lyonnais derrière Dishonored et le très attendu Marvel’s Blade a obtenu un mois supplémentaire pour trouver un repreneur. Un délai qui pourrait être décisif pour les quelque 217 salariés, alors que Microsoft n’écarte toujours pas une fermeture.
La menace plane toujours sur Arkane Lyon. Après plusieurs mois d’incertitude, le studio français, propriété de Bethesda et de Microsoft, bénéficie d’un sursis supplémentaire pour tenter de sauver son avenir. Mais derrière cette prolongation se cache une réalité préoccupante, puisque sans solution viable, l’un des noms emblématiques du jeu vidéo français pourrait bien disparaître.
Xbox accorde un mois supplémentaire à Arkane Lyon
L’information, rapportée notamment par PC Gamer, confirme que Microsoft a accepté de prolonger d’un mois la période de consultation autour de l’avenir du studio. L’échéance initiale, fixée au 13 novembre 2026, devait permettre de rechercher un éventuel repreneur. Le calendrier est désormais repoussé, mais sans que cela garantisse une issue favorable.
« Nous explorons les différentes options possibles, notamment la recherche d’un partenaire pour accompagner le studio dans la suite du développement », explique un porte-parole de Microsoft.
Une piste particulièrement importante pour Marvel’s Blade, le jeu d’action annoncé en 2023 et toujours en production. Selon des sources citées par le média américain, le projet nécessiterait encore plusieurs années de développement, et le fait de trouver un partenaire capable de reprendre le studio et de financer la suite du projet apparaît donc comme un enjeu majeur.
Microsoft précise que les documents évoquant une fermeture ne constituent pas une décision définitive, mais relèvent de la procédure de consultation. Pour les 217 salariés concernés, le répit reste néanmoins très fragile.
Arkane, énième victime de la restructuration de Microsoft ?
Une situation qui s’inscrit dans une très vaste réorganisation chez Xbox, marquée par des suppressions de postes et des changements profonds au sein de ses studios. En juillet, Microsoft a annoncé une nouvelle vague de réductions d’effectifs, avec environ 3 200 postes concernés à terme dans sa division jeux vidéo.
Le groupe poursuit également ses efforts pour réduire ses coûts. Comme nous l’évoquions récemment, Microsoft a proposé à quelque 60 000 salariés un dispositif de départ volontaire indemnisé, signe que la rationalisation dépasse largement le seul périmètre de Xbox.
En septembre dernier, Satya Nadella défendait cette restructuration et affichait sa confiance dans la capacité de la branche gaming à retrouver la croissance. Mais pour Arkane Lyon, les ambitions financières du groupe se heurtent à une question immédiate, à savoir l’avenir des équipes et de leurs projets.
Le mois supplémentaire pourrait permettre de débloquer une solution. À défaut, la fermeture du studio resterait une possibilité bien réelle, et avec elle, la perspective de voir disparaître un savoir-faire français reconnu, avec un studio fondé à la toute fin des années 90, et dont le tout premier projet était un certain Arx Fatalis.
- La rétrocompatibilité au top
- Le Quick Resume, difficile de revenir en arrière
- Taillée pour l'avenir (HDMI 2.1, dolby vision/atmos, VRR)

articles.title: Core Ultra 9, double Ethernet et USB4 : le mini-PC GEEKOM GT1 Mega est à 806,55 €
articles.text:
Le mini-PC GEEKOM GT1 Mega avec Core Ultra 9, 16 Go et 1 To est à 806,55 € (-5 %)
Le GEEKOM GT1 Mega réunit un processeur Intel Core Ultra 9, 16 Go de mémoire vive et une connectique adaptée à plusieurs écrans.
Amazon propose le mini-PC GEEKOM GT1 Mega à 806,55 €, contre un ancien prix de 849 €, également indiqué comme le plus bas des 30 derniers jours. L’économie atteint 42,45 €, soit 5 %. L’ordinateur est vendu par GEEKOM Mini PC FR et expédié par Amazon, avec la livraison gratuite proposée.
Un Core Ultra 9 dans un format compact
Le mini-PC GEEKOM GT1 Mega embarque un processeur Intel Core Ultra 9 185H avec circuit graphique Intel Arc intégré. Cette configuration associe 16 Go de mémoire DDR5 et un SSD de 1 To, sous Windows 11 Pro.
La mémoire peut évoluer jusqu’à 64 Go selon GEEKOM. Le boîtier dispose également d’un emplacement pour un second SSD au format M.2 SATA, afin d’ajouter du stockage.
Deux ports USB4 et deux prises réseau
La connectique comprend deux ports USB4, deux sorties HDMI, des ports USB-A et un lecteur de cartes SD. Le constructeur annonce la prise en charge de quatre écrans 4K simultanément, selon les connexions utilisées.
Deux ports Ethernet 2,5 Gbit/s complètent le Wi-Fi 7. Le mini-PC affiche une note de 4,2/5 sur 13 évaluations Amazon, un nombre encore limité pour apprécier les retours des acheteurs.

articles.title: This rugged tablet combines 30GB RAM with 2TB storage expansion
articles.text:
This 'waterproof' rugged Android tablet has two features no other slates have — a LAN port and HDMI connector
RJ45 Ethernet and HDMI ports built into this rugged tablet
- Ethernet and HDMI connections distinguish the rugged tablet from similar options
- A 20,080mAh battery accompanies 20W charging and lengthy endurance
- The 10.4-inch display combines 120Hz refresh with 1200 × 1920 resolution
Rugtake has introduced the T3 Pro, a rugged Android tablet featuring dedicated connections rarely found together on similar devices.
The first is the RJ45 LAN port, which provides wired Ethernet access without requiring adapters, making physical network connectivity available directly through the tablet.
A separate HDMI connector supports video output to compatible monitors and projectors, eliminating the need for wireless casting or additional display adapters.
Display, processing hardware, and battery capacity
The rugged tablet carries a 10.4-inch IPS panel with 1200×1920 resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, which together yield a pixel density of 225 PPI.
Brightness is rated at 450cd/㎡ and contrast at 1500:1, though the listing gives no reading for visibility under direct sunlight outdoors.
A Spreadtrum G100 processor built with 6nm technology drives the device, and its eight cores reach speeds of 2.3GHz.
Graphics processing relies on the Mali G57 GPU, while Widevine L1 support enables higher resolution playback through compatible protected streaming services.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Although advertised with 30GB RAM, the tablet contains only 6GB physical memory, supplemented by 24GB allocated from its internal storage.
This distinction matters because virtual memory uses storage resources and cannot deliver the same performance characteristics as equivalent amounts of physical RAM.
Its built-in storage reaches 256GB, with microSD card expansion supporting capacities up to 2TB for additional applications, photographs and other files.
An integrated camping lamp produces 380 lumens and includes an SOS signalling function with illumination endurance reaching 240 hours.
On the rear, this device uses a dual camera setup which includes a 20MP primary camera and a dedicated night vision sensor, while a 16MP camera is available for selfies.
The camera supports phase detection autofocus, HDR processing, portrait effects, and underwater photography, while videos can be captured at 1080p resolution.
Rugged construction and outdoor functionality
Designed for demanding environments, the tablet supports IP68 and IP69K protection alongside MIL STD 810H compliance for physical durability.
This implies that it is resistant to dust, water exposure, and certain environmental scenarios to certain levels.
The T3 Pro chassis measures 250.46 × 160.23 × 18.5mm, with grey and black finishes accompanied by a stand and carrying strap.
For cellular communication, the device supports two Nano SIM cards, 4G networks, alongside dual-band WiFi and Bluetooth 5.0.
Additional wireless capabilities include NFC for compatible contactless services, while four satellite navigation systems provide geographical information during travel and outdoor activities.
The device also includes FM radio functionality, glove operation and facial recognition, expanding the available controls beyond conventional touchscreen interaction methods.
Under the hood, it hosts a huge 20,080mAh battery, while 20W USB-C charging provides replenishment without the faster charging rates available elsewhere.
According to the company, on full charge, this device lasts three to five days of regular usage, about 60 days of standby operation, and 48 hours of continuous calling.
The Rugtake T3 Pro currently appears with a $0.00 price on its product page, yet buyers in the US can place an order.
The figure does not mean the tablet is free, and it most likely signals a reservation or preorder while the retail price remains unannounced.

articles.title: El iPhone y el Mac ya ejecutan juegos de Nintendo Switch como aplicaciones nativas y sin emulación
articles.text:
Un proyecto de código abierto permite que el iPhone y el Mac ejecuten juegos de Nintendo Switch como aplicaciones nativas y sin emulación. Se trata de nxnative, una herramienta desarrollada por la comunidad que convierte el código original de los videojuegos en programas que corren de forma directa sobre los procesadores de Apple, sin necesidad de simular todo el hardware de la consola.
La propuesta llega en un momento en el que la Nintendo Switch original ha perdido buena parte de su protagonismo. Lanzada en 2017 con un chip Tegra de NVIDIA de potencia limitada incluso para su época, la consola quedó relegada tras la llegada de la Switch 2, capaz de ejecutar todo su catálogo con mejor calidad y rendimiento.
Cabe señalar que nxnative ofrece una vía alternativa para seguir disfrutando de esos juegos, esta vez desde dispositivos Apple.
Qué es nxnative y cómo logra ejecutar juegos sin emulación
Nxnative es un proyecto de código abierto disponible en GitHub pensado para dispositivos con procesadores ARM de Apple, lo que incluye iPhone, iPad y ordenadores Mac con Apple Silicon. Su diferencia frente a los emuladores tradicionales radica en el método que utiliza para hacer funcionar los juegos.
En lugar de recrear por completo el sistema operativo y el hardware de la Nintendo Switch, la herramienta ejecuta directamente el código original de los videojuegos sobre el procesador de Apple. Esto reduce parte de la carga de procesamiento que normalmente exige la emulación tradicional.
La clave técnica está en la arquitectura compartida entre ambos sistemas. La Nintendo Switch utiliza un procesador NVIDIA Tegra X1 con arquitectura ARM, la misma familia de instrucciones que emplean los chips Apple Silicon.
Aunque existen diferencias entre ambas plataformas, esa coincidencia permite reutilizar gran parte de las instrucciones originales de los juegos sin necesidad de traducirlas a otra arquitectura.
Esta aproximación, basada en técnicas de recompilación y adaptación de código ARM64, es lo que explica por qué nxnative puede ofrecer un rendimiento superior al de la consola original, incluso en dispositivos con especificaciones modestas dentro del ecosistema Apple.
Requisitos para instalar nxnative en iPhone, iPad y Mac
El funcionamiento de nxnative no está disponible para cualquier dispositivo Apple. En móviles, la compatibilidad se limita al iPhone 15 Pro y modelos superiores, mientras que en tablets se requiere como mínimo un iPad con chip M1.
Esta restricción responde a una cuestión técnica concreta: la compatibilidad con las texturas comprimidas BC que utilizan los videojuegos de Nintendo Switch. Sin el soporte adecuado para este tipo de compresión, los juegos no pueden ejecutarse de forma correcta en el dispositivo.
A nivel de sistema operativo, es necesario contar con iOS 26 o iPadOS 26 para que la herramienta funcione. En el caso de los ordenadores Mac, el requisito mínimo es un procesador M1, sin necesidad de versiones posteriores del chip.
Rendimiento de los juegos de Nintendo Switch en dispositivos Apple
Las pruebas realizadas hasta el momento incluyen alrededor de 70 juegos de Nintendo Switch, que en su mayoría funcionan sin complicaciones relevantes. En numerosos casos, el rendimiento obtenido alcanza los 30 cuadros por segundo e incluso llega a duplicar esa cifra.
Decenas de títulos ya se ejecutan a 60 FPS, el doble de la tasa de cuadros habitual en la Nintendo Switch original, que solía moverse en torno a los 30 FPS y con frecuencia de manera inestable.
En el apartado de ordenadores, un video publicado por Andrew Tsai muestra el comportamiento de varios juegos funcionando bajo nxnative. Uno de los ejemplos más llamativos es Monster Hunter Rise, que alcanza los 60 FPS en un MacBook Air de 2020 equipado con apenas 8 GB de RAM.
En equipos con mayor capacidad de procesamiento, como los modelos MacBook Pro, el margen de rendimiento es todavía mayor. En estos dispositivos resulta posible ejecutar varios juegos de Nintendo Switch de forma simultánea, cada uno a 60 FPS, sin que se produzcan caídas significativas en la fluidez.

articles.title: MacBook Neo 2 : on a une bonne et une mauvaise nouvelle sur le futur PC abordable d'Apple
articles.text:
Apple devrait présenter ce mercredi 28 octobre son premier MacBook Pro avec un écran tactile. Mais ce jour, c’est aussi le MacBook Neo 2 qui fait parler de lui, alors qu’il n’est pas attendu avant plusieurs mois. Au programme : quelques améliorations, mais aussi quelques inquiétudes sur le prix du MacBook le moins cher d’Apple.
En 2027, il devrait y avoir un deuxième MacBook Neo
Comme souvent, c’est le journaliste de Bloomberg Mark Gurman qui nous informe des projets d’Apple. Cette fois-ci, il explique qu’Apple préparerait des versions améliorées des MacBook Air (avec la puce M6) et MacBook Neo. Arrivée prévue « pour le premier semestre de l’année prochaine », écrit-il. Un renouvellement pas surprenant, puisque cette machine a rencontré un énorme succès à sa sortie, au point de connaître des ruptures de stocks.
Aujourd’hui, le MacBook Neo est équipé de 8 Go de RAM. Une quantité de mémoire vive qui commence à ne plus suffire : les fonctions d’IA les plus avancées de macOS 27 demandent 12 Go de RAM minimum (et une puce M3 minimum). Avec sa puce d’iPhone 16 Pro, le MacBook Neo fait pâle figure, alors même que la gamme Air commence à 16 Go. C’est pourquoi Apple chercherait à faire passer le Neo 2 à 12 Go de RAM. Le tout grâce à une puce A19 Pro, qu’on trouve dans les iPhone 17 Pro, Pro Max et iPhone Air.
Pour le moment, on ignore quels seraient les autres changements à venir sur cette deuxième itération du Neo. On sait seulement qu’il pourrait être décliné dans de nouveaux coloris ; actuellement il existe en argent, rose, jaune et bleu.
Attention au prix du MacBook Neo 2
C’est là que l’épineuse question du prix arrive. À sa sortie, le MacBook Neo était vendu à 699 euros (et même 599 euros avec la réduction étudiante !), du jamais vu pour un ordinateur portable de la marque. Mais patatras en juin dernier : le prix augmente de 100 euros, avec en cause, la hausse du prix des composants et principalement de la mémoire vive. Et ce n’était pas le seul produit Apple à voir son prix augmenter ce jour-là.
Apple voudrait donc passer à 12 Go de RAM, ce qui aura un impact évident sur le prix. Si le MacBook Neo 2 sort durant la première moitié de 2027 (peut-être en mars comme le premier), difficile de penser que le prix serait maintenu à 799 euros. Une augmentation qui irait à l’encontre même de la raison d’être du modèle Neo : un ordinateur portable « simple », conçu pour la bureautique légère, endurant, qu’on transporte partout, mais surtout qui est abordable en termes de prix.

articles.title: ChatGPT peut désormais fouiller dans vos mails iCloud, et nous avons essayé
articles.text:
ChatGPT accueille les mails et les calendriers iCloud, avec la promesse de simplifier quelques corvées du quotidien. Les utilisateurs Apple vont pouvoir en profiter, mais certains réglages méritent leur attention avant de laisser l’assistant fouiller dans leur correspondance.
Retrouver un mail reçu il y a trois semaines, vérifier l’heure d’un rendez-vous ou remettre la main sur une réservation noyée au milieu de dizaines de messages… On a tous connu ce petit moment de solitude devant sa boîte mail. OpenAI aimerait justement nous épargner ces recherches, parfois interminables, en laissant ChatGPT s’en charger directement. Après Gmail et Google Agenda, c’est au tour des services iCloud d’entrer dans la danse. Et pour une fois, nous avons pu vérifier assez simplement ce que cela change au quotidien.
ChatGPT s’invite dans les mails et les calendriers d’Apple
Depuis le 27 octobre, OpenAI propose deux nouveaux connecteurs permettant de relier ChatGPT à iCloud Mail et iCloud Calendar. Comme le rapporte MacRumors, ils sont accessibles aux utilisateurs gratuits comme payants, notamment en France, depuis le Web, les applications pour ordinateur et iOS.
L'idée n’est pas simplement de demander à ChatGPT de résumer un mail que l’on vient de copier dans une conversation. Le chatbot peut directement rechercher des messages dans votre boîte de réception, consulter votre agenda ou encore préparer des réponses. Le connecteur Mail annonce également la possibilité d’envoyer des messages et de gérer les brouillons, tandis que celui du calendrier permet de modifier des événements.
Prenons un exemple : vous avez reçu une confirmation de réservation il y a plusieurs jours, mais impossible de retrouver le message. Plutôt que de multiplier les recherches dans Mail, vous pouvez demander à ChatGPT de remettre la main dessus. Même principe pour consulter vos prochains rendez-vous, sans avoir à ouvrir Calendrier.
Précisons toutefois que le connecteur Mail accède uniquement à votre messagerie iCloud. Les comptes Gmail ou Outlook que vous avez éventuellement ajoutés à l’application Mail d’Apple ne deviennent pas automatiquement accessibles. Il faudra installer les plugins Google dédiés pour tout centraliser.
L'intérêt est surtout de pouvoir enchaîner les opérations dans une même conversation, sans multiplier les allers-retours entre les applications. Une approche qui peut sembler familière aux utilisateurs de Siri, mais qui prend ici une autre dimension grâce aux capacités conversationnelles de ChatGPT.
Nous avons essayé, et les brouillons arrivent directement dans Mail
Pour connecter sa messagerie, il faut se rendre dans les paramètres de ChatGPT, sélectionner iCloud Mail puis générer un mot de passe spécifique aux applications depuis son compte Apple. La connexion du calendrier s’effectue séparément.
Une fois cette petite formalité accomplie, nous avons demandé à ChatGPT de retrouver les messages reçus pendant la nuit. Le chatbot a pu consulter notre messagerie, puis préparer un brouillon de réponse à partir de l’un des échanges.
Et c’est là que l’intégration devient intéressante : le brouillon était directement disponible dans l’application Mail sur notre Mac. Pas de copier-coller, pas de transfert manuel, simplement un message prêt à être relu et éventuellement envoyé. Pour une tâche aussi banale que répondre à un correspondant, c'est plutôt pratique.
Nous n’avons toutefois pas testé l’envoi direct de messages ni la création ou la modification de rendez-vous. Impossible, à ce stade, de juger la fiabilité de ces opérations.
Reste évidemment la question de la confidentialité. Donner accès à sa messagerie personnelle à un assistant IA n’est pas tout à fait anodin, surtout lorsqu’elle contient des informations professionnelles, des factures ou des échanges privés.
Avant d’activer les connecteurs, mieux vaut donc jeter un œil au réglage « Améliorer le modèle pour tous » dans ChatGPT. Sur les offres grand public, les données récupérées par ces connecteurs peuvent être utilisées pour entraîner les modèles lorsque cette option est activée.
Il est possible de déconnecter les services depuis ChatGPT et de révoquer le mot de passe dédié dans son compte Apple. Attention néanmoins : couper l’accès à iCloud n’efface pas automatiquement les informations déjà reprises dans les conversations ou conservées en mémoire.
Un détail à garder en tête avant de confier à ChatGPT les clés de sa boîte mail.
- Chat dans différentes langues, dont le français
- Générer, traduire et obtenir un résumé de texte
- Générer, optimiser et corriger du code

articles.title: Appareils photo jetables AgfaPhoto : le plaisir de capturer l’instant, la surprise en plus !
articles.text:
Appareils photo jetables AgfaPhoto : le plaisir de capturer l’instant, la surprise en plus !
La photo argentique revient en force ! Et si vous voulez vous lancer, testez les appareils jetables AgfaPhoto : plusieurs modèles sont disponibles pour satisfaire tous les goûts et tous les profils.
Des couleurs chaudes, un grain bien présent (et complètement assumé !), sans oublier ce flash franc qui rappelle les albums des années 2000 : l’argentique séduit de plus en plus, et ce sont les plus jeunes qui le remettent à la mode. Avec ses gammes LeBox et Realishot, AgfaPhoto vous permet de vous y mettre en toute simplicité : vous déclenchez, vous profitez du moment, et vous revivez le charme de la découverte au moment du développement.
Le retour de l’argentique et de l’esthétique Y2K
Plus que jamais, la génération Z a adopté les photos de style vintage, qui rappellent aussi aux générations précédentes de doux souvenirs. Et s’il y a bien un objet accessible et facile à utiliser qui incarne cette tendance, c’est l’appareil photo jetable.
Parce qu’il tient dans une poche, se prend en main en quelques secondes et donne aux images un cachet qu’aucun filtre n’imite vraiment, il dévoile un charme tout à fait unique. Pour beaucoup, c’est aussi une jolie façon de ralentir, et de profiter du moment présent en coupant des écrans ainsi que des réseaux sociaux.
L’art de prendre des photos autrement
Avec 27 à 36 photos par appareil, chaque cliché compte véritablement. Il n’y a pas d’écran pour vérifier le résultat, pas de retouche possible et pas de rafale : vous regardez la scène plutôt que votre téléphone, et vos amis oublient qu’ils sont photographiés. Vos photos sont plus spontanées, souvent plus drôles et toujours uniques.
Autre charme propre à la photo argentique : la magie de l’attente. Car ici, vous ne savez pas ce que vos photos valent avant de les faire développer… Et le jour de la récupération du tirage devient un petit événement !
Appareils photo jetables : plusieurs choix pour différentes occasions
La gamme d’appareils photo jetables AgfaPhoto décline plusieurs modèles qui s’adaptent à toutes les envies et tous les usages :
- AgfaPhoto LeBox Flash / Realishot Flash : 27 photos couleur et un flash intégré. Il se glisse dans le sac pour les soirées, les festivals, les anniversaires et les mariages.
- AgfaPhoto LeBox Ocean / Realishot Splash : ces appareils étanches résistent, selon le modèle, jusqu’à 5 ou 6 mètres de profondeur, tout en offrant 27 photos couleur. Ils accompagnent les vacances, la plage et toutes les activités aquatiques.
- AgfaPhoto LeBox Outdoor : conçu pour la photographie en extérieur, il est parfait pour les voyages, les balades et les journées en plein air. Glissé dans la poche d’un sac à dos, il vous suit en randonnée ou en road trip et garde la trace des paysages comme des pauses pique-nique.
- AgfaPhoto LeBox Black & White : adapté à l’intérieur comme à l’extérieur, cet appareil photo jetable avec flash intégré vous permet de réaliser 36 clichés en noir et blanc. Une manière encore plus originale de tester l’argentique, avec un regard délicieusement rétro.
À offrir, à partager, mais aussi à collectionner !
L’appareil photo jetable devient une idée de cadeau à la fois sympathique et originale. Vous pouvez par exemple en placer un sur chaque table pour un mariage, l’offrir pour un anniversaire ou même en emporter plusieurs à l’occasion d’un voyage entre amis. De cette façon, chacun peut repartir avec ses propres souvenirs, et vivre la même surprise au moment du développement.
Pour les grandes occasions, AgfaPhoto propose d’ailleurs des packs de 2, 5, 10 ou même 20 appareils photo jetables : une belle opportunité de faire plaisir à tout le monde à prix attractif.
Votre prochaine aventure commence sur le site AgfaPhoto : découvrez toute la gamme, choisissez votre appareil et partez le déclencher !

articles.title: Só 3% das empresas viram ganhos com IA, mostra estudo • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Só 3% das empresas viram ganhos com IA, mostra estudo
Gartner diz que 77% dos conselhos esperam mais produtividade e menos custos; 38% das companhias já estouraram o orçamento.
As empresas continuam aumentando os investimentos em inteligência artificial, mas os resultados financeiros ainda estão longe das expectativas. Apenas 3% das organizações conseguiram superar as metas de economia de custos por ganhos de produtividade, segundo dados divulgados pelo Gartner.
O número contrasta com a expectativa dos executivos. Cerca de 77% esperam que a tecnologia aumente a produtividade e reduza despesas. Ao mesmo tempo, 38% das companhias já gastaram mais com IA do que o previsto, e 85% pretendem aumentar os investimentos em 2027.
Segundo o Gartner, uma das dificuldades está na falta de consenso dentro das próprias empresas. Uma pesquisa realizada em julho com 297 diretores de recursos humanos mostrou que 78% dos líderes não estão alinhados sobre onde a IA realmente gera valor. O cenário reforça resultados de outros estudos. Em fevereiro, o Tecnoblog mostrou que mais de 80% das empresas também não haviam registrado ganhos de produtividade com a tecnologia.
Os custos também começam a pesar. Outra pesquisa mostrou que executivos têm dificuldade para entender e prever os gastos com ferramentas de IA, principalmente por causa dos modelos de cobrança baseados no consumo de tokens.
Outro problema é transformar a produtividade extra em crescimento. Em uma pesquisa com 1.865 trabalhadores, o Gartner descobriu que apenas 21% do tempo liberado pelo uso de IA foi redirecionado para atividades consideradas inovadoras.
Para a diretora sênior de análise do Gartner, CV Viverito, as empresas já conseguem liberar parte da capacidade dos funcionários ao automatizar tarefas. A dificuldade está em aproveitar esse tempo para desenvolver novos produtos, serviços ou outras fontes de receita.
A consultoria recomenda concentrar os investimentos nas áreas em que a tecnologia realmente pode gerar valor, distribuir conhecimento sobre IA entre diferentes equipes e redesenhar funções, levando em conta as novas ferramentas.

articles.title: Attackers Hijack Dahua IP Cameras in Ukraine Using P2P Access and Auth Weaknesses
articles.text:
The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) has issued an alert warning of unauthorized remote access to video surveillance systems manufactured by Dahua.
"Cases of compromising IP cameras and DVRs with access to the video stream, changing the device configuration and creating third-party accounts have been recorded," the State Special Communications Service of Ukraine (SSSCIP) said in an alert issued last week.
The primary initial access vector used in the attacks is via Easy4IP, a peer-to-peer (P2P) platform that allows users to remotely monitor homes or small businesses by connecting their Dahua IP cameras, NVRs, and DVRs via a smartphone app or web browser by scanning a QR code or entering the hardware Serial Number (SN).
The agency has warned that the serial numbers have a predictable structure containing a 10-character model prefix that's identical for all units of the same device family and a five-character hexadecimal counter that's incremented almost sequentially (e.g., 7K01F36PCA003E8).
This, in turn, allows attackers to guess them at scale through a brute-force attack and identify if they are connected to the cloud without hitting rate limits or lockouts. As a result, all devices with active P2P functionality are at risk even if they cannot be accessed directly via the internet.
"The assumption that the serial number is unknown to anyone is not a reason to consider the device secure," CERT-UA said.
Authentication barriers are overcome by leveraging weak or known passwords, or by exploiting authentication bypass vulnerabilities in outdated firmware versions, such as CVE-2021-33044 and CVE-2021-33045. CERT-UA has shared the following indicators of compromise associated with the activity -
- Presence of unknown accounts
- Unauthorized configuration changes
- Audit logs containing authentication events using the manufacturer's native protocol (DVRIP) and from a local address (127.0.0.1), a sign of P2P access.
To counter the threat, it's advised to disable the P2P feature if not required, avoid exposing them directly to the internet, and keep the software up-to-date.
The agency has not disclosed who was targeted, when these infections occurred, how many devices had been infected, or who was responsible for the activity. However, the findings share similarities with two clusters of activity that Hunt.io disclosed as targeting IP cameras in Ukraine and Russia.
One of the campaigns, attributed to a Russian-speaking operator, singled out internet-exposed cameras in Ukraine using known Dahua and Hikvision vulnerabilities, ultimately compromising 58 devices. The activity involved the exploitation of the following flaws by integrating Ingram, a publicly available webcam vulnerability scanner -
- CVE-2017-7921 - An authentication bypass vulnerability in Hikvision
- CVE-2020-25078 - A credential disclosure vulnerability in D-Link
- CVE-2020-25169 - An unauthenticated information disclosure vulnerability in Reolink
- CVE-2021-33044 / CVE-2021-33045 - Authentication bypass vulnerabilities in Dahua that allow passwordless login
- CVE-2021-36260 - An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Hikvision.
In parallel, the threat actor is also said to have undertaken scanning and exploitation of TP-Link and MikroTik routers and cameras using vulnerabilities like CVE-2024-53375 and CVE-2024-57049 across 15 European countries, including Ukraine, Poland, Romania, Moldova, Hungary, Czechia, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, the U.K., and Austria.
The second campaign, codenamed Operation CameraSwarm and attributed to a lone threat actor, is believed to have compromised over 14,530 Dahua IP cameras between June 17 and July 22, 2026, using a combination of credential brute-force attacks and the exploitation of the CVE-2021-33044-CVE-2021-33045 chain.
The attack scans for TCP port 37777, which is the default proprietary management and video streaming port used by Dahua, followed by collecting serial numbers, breaking into those devices by employing the aforementioned two exploitation methods, and then deploying a persistent backdoor account ("p2pwn / p2password") on nearly 2,000 cameras in a manner that can survive password change and a factory reset.
"1,923 cameras carry a persistent backdoor account (p2pwn / p2password), installed over RPC after either bypass," Hunt.io noted at the time. "It is stored independently of the admin password and survives a password change and, on most firmware, a factory reset. 283 cameras were reached by serial number alone through Dahua's cloud relay, with no device address and, in most cases, no credentials."
In some instances, the attackers have been found to abuse Dahua's cloud relay to reach cameras behind NATs using only their serial numbers.
Earlier this year, Dutch intelligence agencies warned that Russian actors are compromising IP cameras across the E.U., NATO states, and Ukraine to conduct systematic digital espionage operations and acquire military intelligence.
"This actor performs automated analysis of imagery through image recognition software to conduct targeted searches for military vehicles and the military cargo they are transporting," the July 2026 bulletin said.
"This provides the actor with, among other things, relevant military data, such as E.U. and NATO military transport routes, weapon deliveries to Ukraine, and the locations of Ukrainian military personnel. The information from IP cameras in Ukraine is used in attempts to neutralize Ukrainian military personnel and to destroy their military material."

articles.title: Auroch Announces and Unannounces Mass Layoffs Following Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Launch but
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 27th 2026
Auroch Announces and Unannounces Mass Layoffs Following Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Launch but
Auroch Digital, the studio behind Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun and Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! recently posted an announcement to its LinkedIn page, breaking the news that it would be laying off as much as 25% of its workforce due to "market conditions." However, shortly after the studio announced the layoffs, as covered by GameIndustry, the announcement post disappeared. The original post read:
Auroch Digital via GameIndustryOver the past year our colleagues have delivered amazing games like Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 and Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! to wonderful reception from our players. Despite that creative success, the same market conditions that have challenged so many of our fellow developers have now also affected us. Consequently, we have made the decision to restructure the studio to work through a turbulent and uncertain time in our industry.
The announcement added that the studio will be conducting "a redundancy consultation process affecting around a quarter of roles at the studio."
While the post publicly announcing the layoffs has since disappeared, PC Gamer reports that two employees at Auroch have since confirmed the layoffs. The layoffs come just shy of two weeks after one week after Auroch Digital released Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 and while Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life and Warhammer Survivors are still in development, with a release date for the former pending announcement. It's likely that the announcement will reappear online once the requisite workers unions and government institutions have been informed, as is usually the case with redundancy negotiations.

articles.title: Payer sans déverrouiller son smartphone ? Google Wallet prépare une nouveauté pour aller plus vite
articles.text:
Payer avec son smartphone est très pratique, mais cela demande quelques préalables, comme le fait de vérifier son identité avec votre empreinte digitale ou un code par exemple avant de valider une transaction. Cette validation reste alors active quelques minutes seulement avant d’expirer. Mais Google Wallet pourrait changer cela pour coller à un système proche de ce qui existe déjà dans l’application pour valider les paiements de titres de transport en commun.
De nouveaux indices dans le code de l’application
C’est dans les paramètres de la version 26.42.1003171897 de l’application Wallet que l’on retrouve une option baptisée « Tap to Pay » (« Payer d’un simple geste »), qui fonctionne notamment grâce au NFC. Actuellement, il est déjà possible de désactiver cette option pour les réseaux de transport en commun pris en charge, ce qui permet de valider un trajet sans déverrouiller son appareil. L’arrivée potentielle de cette option pour les paiements de tous les jours offrirait donc un fonctionnement similaire.
Dans l’onglet « Sécurité », « Tap to Pay » apparaît désormais à côté du paiement de titres de transport en commun. – Source : Android Authority
Bien qu’elle soit visible dans le code en dessous de la mention « Indiquez si vous souhaitez valider votre identité lorsque vous utilisez vos éléments stockés dans Wallet », cette option n’est pas encore opérationnelle. En sélectionnant l’option « Tap to pay », l’application se ferme brutalement à cause d’un bug, ce qui rend pour l’instant impossible l’accès aux éventuels réglages ou détails prévus par Google.
La question de la sécurité
Supprimer l’obligation de déverrouiller son smartphone pour régler des achats pose forcément des questions sur la protection des données et la sécurité de vos comptes bancaires. Si un tiers venait à s’emparer du téléphone, l’absence de vérification préalable vous exposerait immédiatement à des risques de paiements frauduleux.
À lire : Google Wallet change complètement l’affichage de vos cartes de paiement, voici à quoi ça ressemble
L’analyse du code ne permet pas encore de savoir si Google prévoit d’ajouter des garde-fous spécifiques pour encadrer cette nouveauté. Dans la mesure où il s’agit d’une option trouvée dans le code, mais pas encore activée, impossible de savoir si Google se décidera à la déployer ou non et dans quelles conditions. En attendant, dites-nous si vous seriez prêt ou non à sacrifier de la sécurité contre de la praticité.

articles.title: Intel Wants a Quantum Business, Classiq Could Help Build One - EE Times
articles.text:
Intel has spent more than a decade developing the components of a quantum computer, from silicon spin-qubit chips to control electronics and software. Now, with its proposed acquisition of Classiq, the company is looking to turn that research effort into a business.
Classiq develops software that helps users design quantum algorithms and run them across different hardware platforms. For Intel, the company adds a layer at the top of the quantum computing stack, along with relationships with enterprises that are preparing for a time when quantum computers can solve commercially valuable problems.
Intel expects the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approvals, to close in the first half of 2027. The company did not disclose the purchase price.
“We haven’t really done much by way of customer engagement or trying to commercialize our technology,” Intel CTO Pushkar Ranade said on a media call. “We believe we have most of the elements of the quantum computing stack except for the very top platform layer,” which Classiq provides.
The acquisition would allow Intel to offer capabilities extending from quantum chips and control electronics to the software used to develop applications, Ranade said. It would also mark a change in the way Intel views its quantum work.
“This is not going to be a high-margin business from day one,” he said. “This is really a bet on the future.”
That future depends not only on Intel’s ability to scale its own spin-qubit technology, but also on its ability to serve an industry pursuing several competing approaches. Intel said it intends to maintain Classiq’s support for other quantum hardware platforms.
From gates to applications
Classiq was founded on the premise that software would become a bottleneck as quantum hardware advanced, said co-founder and CEO Nir Minerbi.
Early quantum software development was largely limited to gate-level programming, a process he compared to designing a chip at the transistor level. Classiq set out to raise the level of abstraction, allowing developers to describe what they want a quantum program to do while its software synthesizes a circuit.
“We embraced many of the technologies that allowed scaling up in classical computing, like EDA technologies, modeling, synthesis, compilation,” Minerbi said on the media call.
That approach, he said, has allowed enterprises, academic institutions, and governments to begin building quantum teams without requiring every member to be a quantum computing expert. Specialists in a particular industry can contribute knowledge of their own problems while working with people who understand quantum algorithms.
Minerbi said companies using Classiq include BMW, Lufthansa, Comcast, Wells Fargo, and Merck. They are developing applications, building teams, and creating intellectual property as they prepare for more capable quantum hardware.
“All of them are preparing for the day when commercial value could be extracted from this hardware,” he said.
The distinction matters: Customers can use the software to explore and prepare applications today, but Minerbi’s description does not mean those applications are already delivering a commercial advantage on Intel quantum processors.
Intel’s existing software will sit below Classiq’s platform. Classiq synthesizes algorithmic quantum circuits, which then flow into Intel’s hybrid quantum-classical compiler and runtime, according to Anne Matsuura, Intel’s senior director of quantum software and system architecture.
“Our compiler deals with both the quantum and classical parts of a quantum program, and it separates them and optimizes them separately,” Matsuura said on the media call.
Matsuura also clarified that Classiq’s algorithmic circuits are different from the physical circuits and wiring in a quantum computer. Its software operates several layers above the hardware. That division of work reflects a broader challenge in quantum computing: connecting an end user’s problem to hardware whose characteristics vary from one system to another.
Izhar Medalsy, co-founder and CEO of quantum software startup Quantum Elements, sees the two companies as bringing complementary capabilities. In his view, Classiq focuses on translating end-user problems into quantum circuits, while hardware providers must address the characteristics of their particular systems.
“Classiq has done a strong job of understanding enterprise needs,” Medalsy told EE Times. “The acquisition is a signal that Intel wants to engage more directly with end users and their applications.”
Quantum Elements approaches the stack from closer to the hardware, using digital representations of quantum processors to help develop software for different systems. Medalsy described its work and Classiq’s as complementary.
Intel’s spin-qubit bet
Intel has chosen silicon spin qubits as the basis for its own quantum hardware. Unlike some competing approaches, spin qubits can be made using processes related to those used in semiconductor manufacturing—a potential advantage for a company with Intel’s fabrication experience.
Ranade said Intel makes qubit chips and control electronics at its fab in Hillsboro, Oregon. The company calls the respective processes 18AQ, with the Q standing for quantum, and 18AC, with the C standing for cryogenic.
The qubit process uses interconnect geometry and design rules based on Intel’s 18A technology, Ranade said, although the process used to make the qubit device itself is distinct and requires some specialized equipment. He said more than 90% of the process equipment is the same.
Owen Lozman, managing partner of Copenhagen-based quantum investment fund 55 North, sees Intel’s semiconductor manufacturing and packaging capabilities as strengths. The company has also demonstrated an ability to run development and testing cycles quickly, he said. But even with those advantages, Intel faces challenges in scaling spin qubits into a useful quantum computer.
“There are a lot of engineering challenges to overcome, even if you get the physics right,” Lozman told EE Times.
Among them are achieving uniformity across spin qubits and managing the wiring and control signals needed as systems grow. Lozman’s fund has invested in Groove, another company developing spin-qubit technology; he said 55 North does not hold a position in Classiq.
While that hardware development continues, Lozman sees value in giving developers software to prepare applications and understand the resources their algorithms will require. He said the acquisition brings Intel an experienced team working on a layer of software it did not previously own.
“I think you have to kind of move early,” he said. “I think they get an early mover advantage.”
The neutrality question
Intel’s commitment to spin qubits gives it a clear direction for its own hardware. Classiq, however, has built its platform to work across a broader field, where companies are pursuing different approaches and the eventual leaders are not yet clear.
That creates a question for Intel: Can it use Classiq to strengthen its own quantum offering while maintaining the confidence of customers and hardware providers that rely on the software to work across platforms?
For Medalsy, independence matters. His company also works with multiple hardware partners, and he said customers pay close attention to whether a software provider is tied to a particular system. “I think keeping yourself independent and not coupled to any specific hardware provider is extremely important,” he said.
Intel said it intends to continue supporting Classiq’s existing integrations and maintain a hardware-agnostic platform. Medalsy believes the company will have to manage the concerns that come with changing ownership. “Time will tell if the industry will accept that as a neutral play or maybe more of a fully integrated approach,” he said.
Asked what commitments or safeguards would maintain partners’ confidence, Minerbi said the reaction so far had been positive. He argued that hardware vendors need access to end users and that Classiq can help provide it. He did not identify specific safeguards during the call.
Intel’s explanation for keeping the platform open rests on a broader view of its role in the industry. Although its own qubit development will remain focused on spin qubits, Ranade said Intel is open to providing foundry services, photonics, and advanced packaging to companies pursuing other modalities.
“We are completely agnostic to the modality” when it comes to the Classiq platform, he said. “Our intent is to have Classiq continue to support all modalities.”
According to Minerbi, the combination could allow Intel to engage with other hardware providers as well as end users. Those relationships could give Intel customers for its manufacturing capabilities while extending the reach of Classiq’s software.
Lozman said he believes Intel has good reasons to preserve that breadth. Supporting other platforms can give the company visibility across the ecosystem, he said, while helping it recover the value of its investment. But Intel will need to manage those relationships carefully, he said, balancing the advantage of ownership against the value of a platform used by others.
“It’s not easy,” Lozman said. “It will take a lot of discipline.”
